description: The Hewlett Packard Enterprise OpenSSL 3 Provider is the FIPS validated cryptographic module for HPE components. The module features robust algorithm support including CNSA algorithms. The module provides services for secure communications, secure key management, data integrity and data encryption to enable enterprise-scale 802.11 wireless LANs (Wi-Fi), secure remote VPNs, and mobility-optimized wired networks.
